name: Fixed Hinglish <-> English clinical anchor pairs for the >0.90 semantic-similarity validation (E2.4)
provenance: Curated from lexicon_mh_v1.json anchor terms + the primary paper's own examples (rona->crying, akelapan->loneliness). Each pair gives the romanized Hinglish form, its Devanagari transliteration (translit_map_hi_v1.json), the English clinical equivalent, and the Tier. Used by Stage 2 Part 2.2 to convert the paper's asserted '>0.90 similarity' into a measured, reproducible cosine result with a t-SNE figure and point-biserial ranking. Versioned so it can be audited and cited.
notes: The validation embeds each side with MuRIL (mean-pool primary, [CLS] = the paper's baseline) and reports cosine on UN-standardised vectors (P4/E2.3). The romanized-vs-Devanagari comparison directly measures the transliteration benefit (E2.1).
